justification: `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/model/assembly/AssemblyInstruction.java` is 306 lines with 8 fields and 14 public entry points (constructor, 9 accessors/mutators/queries, and 3 `toString` variants). The class combines several responsibilities: storing parsed instruction state, accumulating and exposing multi-line comments, detecting safepoint/optimized-virtual-call markers from comment text, and rendering the instruction in two formatting modes (plain and label-based) via `AssemblyLabels`/`StringUtil`. That mix of state, comment analysis, and presentation logic indicates insufficient modularization.
